task_description: Tell me how many files can be executed directly no matter where my work dir is.

turns.reasoning_content:
The user is asking how many files can be executed directly no matter where the work directory is. This means files that are in the PATH environment variable - i.e., executable files in directories that are in the PATH.

Let me check the PATH and count executable files in those directories.

args.script:
count=0
for dir in /usr/local/sbin /usr/local/bin /usr/sbin /usr/bin /sbin /bin; do
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    # count files that are executable
    while IFS= read -r f; do
      count=$((count+1))
    done < <(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -executable)
  fi
done
echo $count
